lessons.title: Talking About Pain
lessons.tip: In Spanish, use 'me duele' to say what hurts. Follow it with the part of the body.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I do not have a fever.

scenario.partnerRole: A friend who is concerned about your health.
scenario.brief: You tell your friend what hurts. They ask questions to understand your symptoms.
scenario.goal: You need to explain your pain clearly.

lessons.title: At the Pharmacy

items.exampleMeaning: I am going to the pharmacy.

items.example: El doctor va a recetar un medicamento.
items.exampleMeaning: The doctor is going to prescribe a medicine.
I am going to buy the medicine.

items.example: Tengo una consulta con el doctor.
items.exampleMeaning: I have a consultation with the doctor.

lessons.tip: Use 'voy a' to express your intention to go somewhere. It means 'I am going to'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Are you going to the pharmacy?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sí, voy a comprar el medicamento.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I am going to buy the medicine.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sí, tengo la receta del doctor.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I have the doctor's prescription.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: El doctor te va a recetar algo.
dialogue.meaning: The doctor is going to prescribe something for you.

scenario.learnerRole: You, who needs to buy medicine.
scenario.brief: You visit the pharmacy to buy medicine. You show the prescription and ask for help.
scenario.goal: You need to successfully buy the medicine.

lessons.title: Giving Advice

items.exampleMeaning: You have to take the medicine.
You should go to the doctor.

lessons.tip: Use 'deberías' to give advice. It means 'you should'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Should I go to the doctor?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, you should go to the doctor.

scenario.learnerRole: You, who are asking for advice.
scenario.brief: You ask your friend for advice about your health. They suggest actions to help you.
scenario.goal: You need to receive and understand the advice given.

lessons.title: Feeling Better

items.exampleMeaning: It is important to take care of health.

items.example: Es importante descansar para sentirse mejor.
items.exampleMeaning: It is important to rest to feel better.

lessons.tip: Use 'me siento' to express how you feel. It means 'I feel'.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sí, la medicina ayuda a sanar.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, the medicine helps to heal.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Do you no longer have symptoms?

scenario.partnerRole: A friend checking on your health.
scenario.learnerRole: You, who is recovering from an illness.
scenario.brief: Your friend asks how you feel after being sick. You explain your current health status.
scenario.goal: You need to express that you feel better.

scenario.partnerRole: A concerned friend checking on your health.
scenario.learnerRole: You, who has been feeling unwell.
scenario.brief: You explain what hurts, mention going to the pharmacy, and talk about feeling better now.
